honestFraming: TINY-DATA groundwork, not a promotion: 217 usable training frames from 2 clips / 2 sessions.
Student memorizes its training session (recall 0.846 in-domain) but fails cross-session (recall 0.074 on wm-volley-02). This is the expected honest outcome at this data scale.
The ~100x LINUX-CPU latency gap (1.02 vs 107.5 ms/frame) is the groundwork signal supporting the latency mandate; accuracy parity is nowhere near demonstrated.
Teacher is a COCO proxy (tennis racket / baseball bat), not a pickleball-paddle-trained model; its outputs are predictions, never observations.
Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were untouched (auto-quarantined by the exporter).
